name: Bubble
description: Cast Bubble at Level 8 for 15 Mana to prepare protection against the next damaging enemy attack without ending your normal action.

protectionTiers.narration: You summon a protective bubble around yourself. It wobbles concerningly. You're pretty sure protective bubbles aren't supposed to do that.
A shimmering bubble pops into existence around you. You poke the inside wall. It makes a surprisingly reassuring *boing*.
Astral light swirls around you and forms a remarkably sturdy bubble. It gives an encouraging little *boing*, apparently very confident in its new job.
An enormous shimmering bubble snaps into place around you with majestic Astral brilliance. It is flawless. It is radiant. You have never felt safer inside something so incredibly poppable.

activationLines: Bubble activates! Your foe strikes the bubble. It responds with a deeply offended *boing*, absorbs {absorbedDamage} damage, and pops.
Bubble activates! The bubble bravely absorbs {absorbedDamage} damage before giving one final determined *boing*. It did its job.
Bubble activates! Your foe hits the bubble for absolutely no good reason. It absorbs {absorbedDamage} damage before popping in protest.
Bubble activates! The bubble absorbs {absorbedDamage} damage, gives your foe one last accusatory *boing*, and pops. It clearly expected an apology.
Bubble activates! Your foe strikes the bubble. It absorbs {absorbedDamage} damage, wobbles dramatically, and pops. Somehow, you get the impression it took that personally.
criticalFlavor: The bubble gives you a confident little *boing*. It has trained its entire life for this moment. Approximately three seconds.
The bubble shimmers proudly. You suspect compliments would only make this worse.
A tiny sparkle circles the bubble like a medal. The bubble seems to accept this honor.
The bubble wobbles majestically. Somehow, it has already developed an ego.
For one glorious moment, you and the bubble feel unstoppable. Mostly the bubble.
